title: Subtree Add, Point Get
prompt:
**Bài toán.** A rooted tree (root 1), parents for v = 2..n, all initial
values 0. q operations: `SA v x` adds x to every node of subtree(v);
`GET v` prints the current value of node v.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 200 000; |x| ≤ 10^9; answers fit in long long.

Euler tour + difference BIT: O(log n) per operation.

tests.name: hand tree
tests.hint: Caterpillar: par = 1→{2,3}, 2→{4,5}, 3→{6}. Subtree(2)={2,4,5}; then root −1 shifts every node: GET 5 = 10 − 1 = 9.

tests.name: single node subtree
tests.hint: Leaf add does not touch the root.

tests.name: n=200000 caterpillar load
tests.hint: 50000 subtree adds + 50000 point gets on a caterpillar tree; the subtree-walk wrong solution costs ~2·10^10 node visits.
